name: logo

test_list.description: WELCOME rows equal the PLAN cell art with the middle dot read as an ordinary space.
COMPACT rows equal the PLAN cell art.
EMBLEM is four spaces, a horizontal bar, the star, a horizontal bar, and four spaces.
The mint highlight is at (7,2) for WELCOME, (5,0) for COMPACT and absent for EMBLEM, and sits on a trace glyph.
The package occupies x=2..12,y=1..5 (WELCOME) and x=1..9,y=1..3 (COMPACT), and the frame corners sit on its corners.
Frame glyphs map to + - | and the star maps to *; exact ASCII rows are asserted.
ASCII rows are all ASCII and keep the grid dimensions.
role_at classifies star, mint, upper/left frame, lower/right frame and pins, package surface and canvas.
glyph(x, y) returns None outside the grid instead of panicking.

output_description: Exact logo cell art, highlight coordinates, ASCII fallback and per-cell colour role.
